Stage 1 Gestation
trainer / trainers / classifier

span.p:
Stage 2 Berkeley Refresh
trainer / trainers / classifier
Full real-image semantic refresh trains the classifier on Berkeley and payload supervision.

span.p:
Stage R Transformer
trainer / trainers / transformer

span.p:
Stage G Generator
trainer / trainers / gan
Generator and discriminator co-train against payload supervision, classifier guidance, and adversarial pressure.

span.p:

Accepted transformer renders are recycled into a dedicated wave classifier and fed back as wave-level quality signals.

span.p:
